solves.reason: 본문 'not because highly similar in appearance but because they serve similar functions' → (A)=similar, (B)=functions. 'higher meaning' → (C)=meaning. ②
exemplars 'become associated' (not separated). 'same underlying concept' (not external). 'explanatory function' (not decorative). ③ associated-underlying-explanatory
'different manifestations of the same underlying concept' → (A)=manifestations. 'perceived similarities' → (B)=perceived. 'included in the category' → (C)=included. ①
① strangers: 본문 'objects are members' → 'strangers'는 부적절. members가 원문.
② avoiding: 본문 'donating money to a faith-based charity' → avoiding은 종교적 행동과 반대
④ denial: 본문 'gives some account for why' → denial(부인)은 account(설명)의 반대
빈칸: 'not because highly similar in ____' → appearance. 본문에 'similar in appearance' 존재
빈칸: 'meaning ____ that ties behaviors together' → structure. 본문 'meaning structure' 확인
빈칸: 'the "____" that holds the category together' → glue(접착제). 비유적 표현으로 glue가 적합
apparent = obvious(명백한). not immediately apparent → not immediately obvious와 동의
exemplars = representatives(대표적 사례). exceptions(예외)는 반대, obstacles/definitions는 무관
merely = only(단지). grouped based merely on = grouped based only on
underlying(근본적인)의 반의어 = surface(표면적인). fundamental은 유의어
perceived(인식된)의 반의어 = unnoticed(인식되지 않은). noticed는 유의어
(A)(B)의 reflect = '반영하다'. ① 빛 반사(물리). ② reflect on=숙고하다(자동사). ③ reflect genuine concern=반영하다 ← (A)(B)와 동일 용법. ④ 물리적 반사
'quality of being religious or deeply devoted to a faith' = religiosity(종교성). ① category ② function ③ manifestation은 불일치
Attending church, __(donate)__ money ... 병렬구조. Attending과 동형 → donating(동명사)
elements that are __(group)__ → 수동태 be+p.p. → grouped
exemplars become associated ... ____. 앞에서 외모만으론 부족 → 더 높은 의미에 기반. ④ based on some higher meaning
a theory that gives some account for ____. 왜 이 요소들이 포함되는지 설명 → ③ why these elements are included
